messages.subject: new renjin-commits mailing list
parts:
Hi all,
Noticed that actual discussion on the renjin-dev mailing list was being drowned out by auto commit messages from google code. From now on, commits (and their comments) will be sent from renjin-...@googlegroups.com. You can subscribe to these here:

http://groups.google.com/group/renjin-commits

Best,

Alex
